en.dir.title: Housekeepers · Gardeners · Laundry · Handymen
en.dir.emptyHint: Know a good housekeeper, gardener, laundry with pickup, or handyman? Send them this page to list themselves.
en.page.how.title: How it works
en.page.how.body: Housekeepers, gardeners, laundries that pick up and deliver, and handymen list themselves with a form. Mot Dang checks each listing and each photo before it shows; some wait for a person. Photos show the work or the place only; a photo with a person or a child in it is refused. People who want to hire contact them by the LINE or phone they gave, and agree the work and the pay between themselves. The person listed can change or remove the listing with the private link they get after sending the form.
en.legal.notEmployer: Mot Dang is the notice board. The person hiring and the worker contact each other and agree terms directly.
